title: How this repository reaches users
boundary: The /m:os source repository, its build and validation steps, the hosted MCP deployment, and npm distribution.
purpose: Show how code changes become validated changes and then usable releases; distinguish the working hosted service from the npm registry placeholder.
timeHorizon: Current delivery path; counts and rates are unknown unless noted.

actors.label: Maintainers
actors.description: Maintain the source, run validation, and respond to release blockers.

flows.label: Deploy to hosted MCP
flows.delay: Deployment follows a successful push to main.

flows.label: Publish working npm package
flows.delay: The registry currently exposes a staged placeholder instead of the executable package.

causalLinks.label: A larger unchecked queue requires more maintainer attention

assumptions.text: A change set is used as a conceptual unit for movement through validation and deployment; production capability counts are not available.

evidence.text: The repository typecheck, build, CLI/MCP/deployment smoke checks, and documentation check pass for the current main commit.
The shared hosted MCP responds successfully and serves the current stock-and-flow App resource.
The npm scope currently exposes only 0.0.0-stage, without the executable package contents.
